candidate_ledger.continuation_case: Modest growth and cooling inflation allow equities to grind higher with Fed on hold
evidence: June nonfarm payrolls increased by 57,000 with April and May revised down by 74,000 combined
June CPI decreased 0.4% monthly and core was unchanged
candidate_ledger.invalidation_condition: Unemployment rises sharply or core inflation reaccelerates in July CPI
candidate_ledger.reversal_case: Data surprises to the downside trigger recession fears or upside inflation forces hawkish pivot
candidate_ledger.time_window_catalyst: FOMC meeting July 28-29 and BEA advance Q2 GDP July 30

candidate_ledger.reversal_case: Large-cap growth and tech rebound sharply on positive catalysts
candidate_ledger.time_window_catalyst: FOMC statement and subsequent sector performance into August CPI

candidate_ledger.continuation_case: Value factor and large-value stocks extend relative strength in a soft-landing or lower-growth regime

candidate_ledger.continuation_case: Energy equities hold gains if oil stabilizes near forecast and companies maintain capital discipline

candidate_ledger.continuation_case: Staples continue as defensive play with cautious consumer spending

Further decline in oil prices below EIA projections weighing on energy
Hawkish surprise at FOMC or hotter July CPI data
Broader equity market correction from weaker-than-expected GDP or jobs data

portfolio_rationale: Allocates equally across equal-weight US equities, large value, financials, healthcare and energy to exploit recent relative strength and soft macro data favoring rotation and defensives over the concentrated S&P 500 over the one-month window.
rationale_summary: Soft inflation, weak payrolls and relative performance data support higher base-case returns for value, financials, equal-weight, healthcare and energy versus SPY.
